name: Wraith
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: Can move through creatures and objects like Difficult Terrain; takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: Disadvantage on attack rolls and Perception checks while in sunlight.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.desc: If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by the same amount.

actions.name: Create Specter
actions.desc: The wraith raises the spirit of a Humanoid that died violently within the last minute as a Specter under its control (up to seven at once).

desc: Pure malice left behind when a wicked soul refused to die. Its touch drains life itself.
